_: Every value marked ?? must come from Il2CppDumper (or tools/metadata_structure.py) on the exact build you are reading. Nothing here is a guess: the reader refuses to start while any ?? remains, and says which key it is waiting for.
_container: The object that holds the player list. `static_offset` is the RVA of the static field that points at it (script.json: Address). The reader does base + static_offset, reads a pointer, and that is the container object.
_list: The list object itself: a managed array (Il2CppArray) or a List<T>. For an array, data starts at array_object_header_size and count is at the array length offset - both are constants in the runtime, not per-build.
_player: Offsets are from the start of the Player object. position is a Vector3 field (12 bytes). If the game only exposes a Transform, set transform_offset instead and position will be read from Transform + transform_pos_offset.
_camera: Camera.main is a static. The two matrices are fields on the camera object. worldToScreen is recomputed from them; nothing in the game is called.
